source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesSpirit CrossingReleases 11/16/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/21/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCAlcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingWelcome to your strange new home.Glide through pastel clouds, heal troubled spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend.In Spirit Crossing, you can play together or by yourself, for as long as you like. Each stranger you befriend blooms into color, revealing the unique person behind their gray shadow. Make a friend, or just quietly share the same little corner of the world. Our game is built around small acts of kindness, and the way even brief connections can make us feel a little less alone.Show off your style with hundreds of hairstyles, dyes, head coverings, prosthetics, and mix-and-match outfits, then bring it all to life with dozens of expressive emotes. Come as you are, or try on someone new! Then design the ultimate space to host your friends, from cozy cottage to full-blown castle. Fill it with enough furniture, plants, rugs, lamps, and tiny trinkets to ensure no shelf goes tragically undecorated.From Spry Fox:Spirit Crossing has been in development for over five years. At the heart of this project is our belief that games should bring people together, encourage kindness, and reduce loneliness in this chaotic world we live in.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):This product can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2. source.title: The Outer Worlds 2’s first DLC arrives December 2
source.evidenceText: November 10, 2026November 10, 2026 The Outer Worlds 2’s first DLC arrives December 2 2 0 34 Like this The first in a two-part Side Effects Guaranteed narrative adventure arrives soon, with part two coming spring 2027. Mikey Dowling Director of Communications, Obsidian Entertainment The time has come to expand on the experience for The Outer Worlds 2 with the first of a two-part story expansion, Side Effects Guaranteed, arriving on December 2. After a distress signal from a derelict ship is picked up, you and your crew quickly get embroiled into the story of an abandoned settlement, a power struggle for the future of the Sub Rosa criminal organization, and the fate of a team who has been subjected to something that will cause them all to die from explosive cell death. Really, it’s more a liquefaction than explosion, but it means death nonetheless. Play Video A brand new story filled with moral quandaries and consequences big and small isn’t the only thing you’ll experience in the first DLC. An Earth Directorate Commander should always be sure to have a weapon at their side, and there are five new weapons to add to the arsenal. Such as the Immobilizer. Think of it like a gun that makes gravity forget to exist around its target, allowing them to float in the air, so you can switch to another weapon and pick them off as you like. Great for combining with grenades for anti-gravity explosions or the Tactical Time Dilation device for slowing down time and getting some critical shots in. There is also the 1/6 Resolver that allows every sixth bullet that is fired from it to pack an extra special punch. For those who built their characters just right, they won’t have to empty the gun every time to get that critical hit, either. Other weapons include a weapon that does additional damage to creatures, a special Tossball Stick, and a new plasma weapon for some energy fun. Yet it isn’t all about the weapons. Side Effects Guaranteed will also bring with it a level cap increase up to 36, new perks, new flaws, and a new Sub Rosa radio station with 20 new songs. There is also the all-new region of Elysium Valley to explore with unique quests and new facilities to make your way through. That’s a lot of new! While the events of the DLC do trigger right before the point of no return in the main game, there is also a way to jump easily into the action. From the main menu if you start a new game, you will see an option to start Side Effects Guaranteed directly. This will load a pre-made character at level 27 that you can assign skill points and perks to so you can experience the DLC however you’d like and get started right away. Not happy with the character you made (or the one you already have)? Coming to everyone at the same time as the release of Side Effects Guaranteed is a new update that will allow players to respec their character at any time. And for those who want more skills to play around with, a new addition to the custom game options allows you to adjust how many skill points you get per level. Find the balance that is right for you. Or become an Earth Director demi-god. Your worlds, your way. But remember, however you decide to deal with Sub Rosa or the subjects of Elysium Valley will have consequences. Side effects, some might say, that will lead directly into the next installment of The Outer Worlds 2 two-part story expansion when it releases in the spring of 2027. Until then, may skill catch you where fortune fails. Side Effects Guaranteed releases on December 2nd or is available in the Premium Edition or Premium Edition Upgrade for The Outer Worlds 2.
